title: Appointed as Assistant
original: You work so hard, Doctor.

title: Appointed as Assistant
original: Doctor, what's wrong? Oh, I'm fine, just a little tired. Please check these two files in a moment. A lot of new Operators have joined Rhodes Island, and we can't disappoint them.

title: Appointed as Assistant
original: Doctor, are you busy? Oh, it's fine if you don't have time to chat. I need to get some work done too, how about we eat together after we're done?

title: Talk 1
original: Dr. Kal'tsit told me you have to be 100% focused on your work to maximize efficiency. So... yes, that's what I'm gonna do!

title: Talk 1
original: Rhodes Island and this land at large have already lost so much. We will put a stop to it... Rage may destroy us, but when confronting malice, ever more people have no other choice. Until the land finds peace, no one will be able to extinguish this fury.

title: Talk 1
original: Doctor...? All is well. I'm just reading this book. I suddenly realized that Theresa once read it to me, though even now I don't know how it ends. Tears...? Maybe it's because... it's such a heartwarming story.

title: Talk 2
original: Rhodes Island has achieved cruising speed, Doctor. Would you mind sorting out the navigation log for me?

title: Talk 2
original: My rings look different? I couldn't hide it from you, Doctor... You're right, one of them broke. But it's okay, Dr. Kal'tsit helped me switch it for a new one. Did... that have something to do with when I blacked out, you ask? Doctor...

title: Talk 2
original: Yes, another ring of mine broke. Dr. Kal'tsit says no material could stand against such intense emotion. But even though this ring is broken, I still want to keep wearing it. It's both a restraint and a blessing. I'll make good use of it.

title: Talk 3
original: I still have a lot to learn as leader of Rhodes Island. I hope you'll be there to guide me on our path to the future.

title: Talk 3
original: In this whole operation, we gained no commercial profit at all, and we gave so much... But there are many things you can't weigh in terms of business value. Rhodes Island was never a company born exclusively for profit, and this land needs more than just physical medications.

title: Talk 3
original: Doctor, Blaze invited me to an event she's organizing. It's to celebrate our return to the landship, and a lot of elite operators will be there. Will I be joining them for drinks? No, of course I... Doctor, you and Dr. Kal'tsit are always looking after me, so you should know I've grown up a bit, but not that much.

title: Talk after Promotion 1
original: Maybe it's just wishful thinking, but I hope Rhodes Island can be like a second home to everyone.

title: Talk after Promotion 1
original: Chernobog's Reunion... it's over, and is there any more point to denouncing what they've done? Think of the people who trampled them, abused them, massacred them... hatred breeds hatred. That was something that should've never happened in the first place.

title: Talk after Promotion 1
original: I've come to understand more and more how difficult it was for Theresa. What should I do? I think... I'll go and see Kazdel, as it is today. W will stand with me. And... there'll be more, others, in the future… Yes, I'm feeling more confident now.

title: Talk after Promotion 2
original: Making it this far has cost us so much. Sometimes, I can't help but ask myself... is it really worth it?

title: Talk after Promotion 2
original: Once, there was a Sarkaz betrayed, who walked this land bent on vengeance, only to cast his own life into the cycle of revenge. What I can't understand is, he'd already settled on his own end before he drew his sword. In his rage… he settled on death, with a clear mind.

title: Talk after Promotion 2
original: I touched and felt Theresa's every emotion. She was full of love and hope... for this great land, the Sarkaz, the people by her side, and herself. But all of it came to a sudden end, along with her life. She was holding onto so much sorrow... and so am I.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
original: Sometimes I remember where I came from... It was cold, and the air smelled of rusted copper. Rhodes Island is a cozy place in comparison. I'll do everything I can to protect our home.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
original: Death should be carved into our memories, never to be forgotten, no matter who brought that death about, nor who was brought to. Our mistakes will never be right... those scars should always remind us, warn us how frail we are.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
original: Dr. Kal'tsit has seen so much death. She was forced to watch many of her loved ones go, one by one. It's just... too painful. I've grown up now, so I can shoulder more responsibility for her. She doesn't have to walk alone anymore. Doctor, I want her to know that we're here for her.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
original: Hehe… Dr. {@nickname}, let me tell you something: I picked up the violin again.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
original: Even now, they still sometimes come to mind. Misha's gaze, FrostNova's roars, Patriot's cries... Ace, Scout, and so many operators sacrificed their lives for a single belief. But the Infected all across Terra—what is it that they've died for?

title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
original: I expected as much... Thank you. Oh, Doctor? Do you want to talk with 'Civilight Eterna' too? Alright, come over here, don't be nervous... Just like this, feel the flowing energy. Feels like she's holding your hands, right? You'll get along well, I'm certain of it, and I always have been.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
original: We've still got a long, long way to go, Doctor. This might be a journey without an end, but as long as you're with me, we'll be okay.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
original: Doctor... recently... have I been a little less like myself? The nameless anger that rises up, time and again... is that mine? If so... no, even if so, I won't give up. I will protect you, Doctor, by this sword.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
original: Doctor, I can feel your guilt, confusion... and sorrow. But you shouldn't be trapped by your past. This is what Theresa and I both wish for you. We still have lots of work to do. The one who ignited the flame of hope may no longer be with us, but the fire still burns. Babel never truly fell.

title: Idle
original: There's still lots of work that needs to be done, Doctor. We can't afford to have you resting.

title: Idle
original: Doctor, are you okay? Do you need to rest a little? I'll help carry you. Don't worry, I'm doing fine. So long as you're rested.

title: Idle
original: Doctor, are you well-rested? If you're still feeling tired, you don't have to force yourself to work. I'm here, after all.

title: Onboard
original: I'm so glad you're back, Doctor. Now we can walk this path together, me with you, and you with me.

title: Onboard
original: Doctor, it's so good to see you. My appearance? Um, please don't be afraid... I can explain this. But don't worry, Doctor. Whatever happens, I won't ever let you come to harm. I swear it.

title: Onboard
original: Don't worry, Doctor, this is another one of my powers. I still can't heal every injury I see.... but I'll keep you safe. I'll protect the ones I love.

title: Watching Battle Record
original: I see... thank you, Doctor! I've learned so much from you.

title: Watching Battle Record
original: 'If the fight is unavoidable...' This is what the person I most trusted once taught me.

title: Watching Battle Record
original: Could I use all my different powers in the same fight? Oh, Doctor. I was just talking to myself.

title: Promotion 1
original: I'm so excited to fight by your side again, Doctor!

title: Promotion 2
original: What I saw that day... the despair stuck in my throat, hopelessly trying to scream... I want to bury it all deep inside my mind and never let it out…

title: Added to Squad
original: Got it.

title: Added to Squad
original: Got it.

title: Added to Squad
original: Yes, I understand.

title: Appointed as Squad Leader
original: I won't let you down.

title: Appointed as Squad Leader
original: I shoulder the wrath of so many others.

title: Appointed as Squad Leader
original: I can feel so much sorrow… so much sadness…

title: In Battle 1

title: In Battle 3

title: In Battle 3
original: 'With what do I answer your failure of justice?'

title: In Battle 3

title: In Battle 4
original: I hear... someone crying?

title: In Battle 4
original: Do not... make me angry.

title: In Battle 4
original: 'Through the grim perils of the longest night, we shall breach into the promised dawn.'

title: 4-star Result
original: No matter how difficult the mission, we can handle it as long as you're here, Doctor. I've never doubted you.

title: 4-star Result
original: Doctor, thank you for always supporting me. Our battles will only get harder from here, but we can't give up.

title: 4-star Result
original: I don't want to lose anyone else. I'll carry on this fight, for every sacrifice, and all those still alive.

title: 3-star Result
original: We may have achieved a perfect victory, but we still can't let our guard down.

title: 3-star Result
original: How long do we fight? How long until the flames of anger on this land die down...

title: 3-star Result
original: The flames of hatred still spread. I'll try to extinguish them, no matter... how many times it takes.

title: Sub 3-star Result
original: Well done, Doctor! You must be exhausted. Be sure to rest when you need it.

title: Sub 3-star Result
original: Doctor, good job. Let me handle the clean-up.

title: Sub 3-star Result
original: I've made a few slips... No, it's not your fault, Doctor. I could have done better here.

title: Operation Failure
original: I'm fine... Get it together, everyone!

title: Operation Failure
original: ...What happened? This shouldn't have...

title: Operation Failure
original: I won't let anyone hurt you, Doctor. Hold onto me, and don't let go, okay?

title: Assigned to Facility
original: Phew... we can take a little breather now, right?

title: Assigned to Facility

title: New Year's blessing
original: Happy New Year, Doctor! Please make sure you get lots of rest today... Y-You've already worked for the better part of the day? Did I get here too late? Sorry...Blaze just asked me to get my height measured... Oh, you're just joking? Thank goodness.

title: New Year's blessing
original: For a brief moment, I could hear a voice growling deep within my heart: The suffering on these lands is eternal, and nothing can be turned around in such a short span of time... No, I refuse to accept that, Doctor. I trust that our journey and our fight are meaningful.

title: New Year's blessing
original: Where's that form...? Hmm... I'm looking for a financial statement from Closure. Where did I put it...? Right here! Oh, it's a summary report from HR... Which reminds me, I haven't checked the new purchase order yet either... Doctor, I won't make it to the party. So I'll wish you a happy new year right here. Ahem-hem: happy new year! Oh? You want to stay with me?

title: Greeting
original: Welcome home, Doctor!

title: Greeting
original: Welcome home, Doctor!

title: Greeting
original: Welcome home, Doctor.

title: Birthday
original: Doctor, if you can remember even some of your past... That would make me really happy. Right, I'm still not very good at the violin, but... since you're the only one here to listen, there's a song I'd like to practice. A sort of nostalgic song.

title: Birthday
original: Does it feel strange at all to celebrate a birthday that you don't remember? Does it... feel like... that's not you? It doesn't? Thank goodness. Doctor, I'd like to take out my violin and give it another try. Perhaps this time I won't break any strings.

title: Birthday
original: Happy birthday, Doctor. Do you want me to... play the violin like before? I didn't get to sneak in much practice... Oh, the time we have to ourselves just gets shorter and shorter these days... But luckily, I know your favorite tune by heart, and I'll never forget it.

title: Anniversary Celebration
original: I remember the names of those who've left us, and I can still feel the lingering fear, rage, and pain of battle. But if I'm to give a speech in front of everyone, I want to tell a story of hope instead. Doctor, I'm a little nervous... Could you hold my hand, please?

title: Anniversary Celebration
original: There is no avoiding pain if we are to end the vicious cycle that is hatred. Nevertheless, I believe there will come a day when I can set down this blade. Doctor, until that day comes, I'll protect you at all costs. I only hope that... it won't be you who gets hurt.

title: Anniversary Celebration
original: Another year has passed, and Rhodes Island is still sailing onwards. Doctor, tonight was just so wonderful I wish I could hide it away, deep in my mind. Thank you for staying by my side. We'll spend this very same day next year, together.
